reason: The explicit extraction was removed, but `logRequest` now logs through `m.logger.FromContext(ctx)` (pkg/services/pluginsintegration/clientmiddleware/logger_middleware.go:58), which runs every registered contextual log provider (pkg/infra/log/log.go:203-217). The tracing service registers one that appends `traceID` from `TraceIDFromContext(ctx, false)` (pkg/infra/tracing/tracing.go:91-97), so traceID is still on plugin request logs without `ContextualLoggerMiddleware` adding it.
